title: Groww launches US stocks & ETFs to open global market access for Indian investors with Alpaca
summary: Groww launches US stocks and ETFs for Indian investors through GIFT City, powered by Alpaca's brokerage infrastructure.
body_markdown:
[Groww](https://groww.in/?ref=alpaca.markets) , a Bengaluru-based investment platform with 22 million (2.2 crore) transacting users* and the largest Indian stockbroker by active customers, recently launched US stock investing, powered by Alpaca, a global leader in agent-first brokerage and clearing infrastructure.¹


With the launch, eligible Groww users can invest in US stocks and ETFs and explore global companies and themes alongside the Indian investments they already manage in the Groww app. We spoke with[Harsh Jain, Co-Founder & COO at Groww](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harshjainiitd/?ref=alpaca.markets) , to learn more about the launch and what it means for its users.


## From mutual funds to a multi-asset investing platform


Groww was founded in 2016 with the goal of empowering people in India by making finance simple, transparent, and accessible to everyone, regardless of where they lived or how much experience they had.2 At the time, millions of Indians were saving money, but very few were investing, as financial products often felt complex and inaccessible, especially for first-time investors and users outside of metro cities.


The company launched in 2017 as a mutual fund investment platform.2 While mutual funds were a natural entry point for new investors, Groww’s broader mission was always to help more Indians participate in wealth creation. That mission shapes what Groww offers and how it designs each product.


Since 2017, Groww has expanded into a broader investing and wealth platform with over $38 billion (₹3.8 lakh crore) in user assets.1 Today, users can access Indian stocks, mutual funds, IPOs, ETFs, derivatives, commodities, bonds, and a margin trading facility, alongside Groww’s wealth management offering.1 US stocks and ETFs were the latest addition to Groww’s offering, strengthening their multi-asset ecosystem beyond domestic markets.


## Closing the gap to global markets


US Treasury data show that holdings of US equities by residents of India rose from $6 billion in 2020 to $28.7 billion as of June 2025.4,5 Demand for international markets has continued to increase as investors seek access to international tech and AI companies, which have limited representation on Indian exchanges.3 Groww is aiming to close this gap with the launch of US stocks and ETFs.


The offering runs through Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT City), India’s international financial services center, with the company securing a license for global investing from the International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) in July 2026, paving the way for this launch.3


“India’s investing landscape has evolved significantly, with investors becoming more informed, digitally connected, and focused on building long-term wealth,” said Jain. “They follow global businesses closely and there is a rising interest among Indian retail investors in global themes such as artificial intelligence, robotics, SaaS platforms, semiconductors, electric vehicles and space technology. At the same time, India’s investing culture is maturing. Our launch of US stocks investing on GIFT City’s rails is a step towards meeting this evolving need by giving our customers access to global companies and the opportunity to build more diversified portfolios. We believe this aligns with the increasing sophistication of India’s retail investor ecosystem and growing demand for world-class investment opportunities.”


Through Alpaca’s brokerage infrastructure, eligible Groww users can now:


- Invest in more than 10,000 US stocks and ETFs
- Buy fractional shares for as little as $1, helping make investing more accessible
- Access US-listed companies and ETFs to broaden the range of investment opportunities available within their portfolios


Groww designed the experience to be intuitive, as a significant share of their users are first-generation investors who expect financial products to be digital-first. With the goal to make investing in US stocks as simple and familiar as investing in Indian markets, their focus has been to make global investing feel accessible rather than intimidating.


The company also sees GIFT City as an important step in India’s ambition to develop globally competitive financial infrastructure. As financial markets become more interconnected, Groww believes Indian investors should be able to participate in opportunities beyond geographic boundaries with broader access and investment choices, and that GIFT City plays a meaningful role in making that possible.


## Engineering cross-border access with regulated infrastructure


Groww chose Alpaca as its infrastructure partner for its API-first approach, multi-asset capabilities, and commitment to building a tailored, India-first product experience through the[acquisition of Zincmoney](https://alpaca.markets/blog/alpaca-enters-indias-gift-city-broker-dealer-market-through-zincmoney-ifsc-acquisition/) . As a US-headquartered, self-clearing broker-dealer, Alpaca supports execution, clearing, and custody for US securities, enabling Groww to stay focused on its user experience.


“Groww has made investing more accessible for tens of millions of people across India, and we are proud to support its expansion into US markets,” said[Yoshi Yokokawa, Co-Founder and CEO of Alpaca](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yoshiyokokawa?ref=alpaca.markets) . “Our role is to engineer reliable, regulated brokerage infrastructure so partners like Groww can focus on their users. This launch reflects how GIFT City is opening new pathways for people in India, and we look forward to supporting Groww as it scales access to global markets.”


## What’s next for global investing at Groww


Following a phased rollout, US stocks and ETFs are now available to every Groww user.7 With the rollout complete, Groww is focused on helping users get started and maintaining a reliable experience as adoption grows.


Groww sees itself as a long-term builder of India’s investing ecosystem and plans to continue expanding its international offering. As that next phase develops, Alpaca’s infrastructure will look to support Groww’s broader effort to open global markets to users across India.
